title: An Educational Highlight of our Vacation
text:
Adrian was wonderful!

In advance, he sent a very descriptive message of the upcoming tour so we could dress appropriately and have breakfast in advance.  The pick up was timely.

Adrian's knowledge of the escape routes in this mountainous region were fascinating and comprehensive. Given our interest in Andorra, he also showed us it's main sections and noted where skiers stay during the season should we return. 

One highlight was the restaurant he recommended for lunch. Cooking our own beef tenderloin on a hot stone eliminated the often complaint of an overcooked meal. Perfect!

title: Andorra & Pyrenees WWII Escape Route
text:

title: Excellent Tour with Adrian R as your Tour Guide!!
text: My husband and I took this private day tour from Barcelona to Andorra and the Pyrenees focusing on the WWII escape routes.   Adrian R. was our guide and was excellent!! He knew so much of the history of that time period, the local history and some of the local heroes.  Our tour included several stops highlighting the historical significance of escape routes through the Pyrenees. title: WWII Escape Routes from France
text: Adrian was a terrific guide. It was quite a learning experience for me. The twists and turns on the route make it a little confusing, but the maps helped. I would have liked a few more maps to better understand the routes taken by the refugees/escapees. Adrian adapted the tour to our specific interest and was willing to stop along the way for photo ops. All in all it was by far the best tour we had on our 3-week trip. I highly recommend Adrian to anyone interested in this part of history.
